title: Normalized common-quotient pullback comparison data
statement: For essentially small sites J and K, a left-adjoint geometric inverse image with its algebraic ring and module inverse images [def-pur-ringed-coefficient-projection-data], and normalized derived scalar extensions [def-weil-pbc-successive-derived-quotient-data], define the following actual computation data. A Model consists of an additive ordinary functor, a derived functor and its specified homotopy computation arrows; composition uses the two computation arrows and the homotopy compositor. A ModelIso is an ordinary and a derived natural isomorphism with the explicit computation square on flat-term K-flat representatives. For R→B and inverse-image B→Bprime, define ordinary and derived pullbacks, source inverse-image of restriction, target restriction of pullback, their canonical computation maps, and Insertion with the scalar-unit section formula and its representative square. For a common quotient tower [def-weil-pbc-common-quotient-tower-presentation], Comparison records reduced insertion as natural isomorphisms in each quotient coefficient category, the normalized inverse via the coefficient tensor comparison, and the actual adjunction-unit and quotient-transition squares. CompositionData and IdentityData specify ordinary section formulas and ModelIso squares for the compositors and unitors. CompositionLaw and IdentityLaw are the unreduced pasting or identity equality and its scalar extension at every quotient level. Coherence quantifies these laws for all the specified compositors and unitors. These are presentation data for the existing operations, and assert no existence theorem or insertion coherence.
